title: No rerun operation for the entry run after JOB-02 becomes a workflow
source: RWB-E2-001 s5 X6 and s12; P3 REST operation list in the context pack
description: The legacy story restarts JOB-02 with POST /admin/jobs/{jobId}/rerun and refuses a second start with 409 MSG-P2-006. In the target JOB-02 is an event-started Temporal workflow of rwb-case and the P3 REST operation list holds no job rerun operation, so the operation that requests a rerun of a business date, and the answer while the workflow runs, is not specified.
evidence: RWB E2 001 v1 s5 X6, s12 endpoint table; FSD P3 A1.5 trigger; context pack P3 REST operations provided (22 rows, none for a job or a run)
proposed: Fix the rerun request as an admin operation on the rwb-case base answering 409 MSG-P2-006 while the workflow for the business date runs, or drop the manual rerun and keep the duplicate-start rule only.

title: Paths and payloads of the P2 hand-over and P1 ledger contracts
source: RWB-E2-001 s12 published interfaces; context pack naming rules
section: s3 Preconditions; s5 note; s10; s12.2
description: The legacy calls AccountQuery.findAtOrAboveDpd, EfsHistoryQuery.forAccount, InteractionLedger.appendEfsHistory and the REC-05 break write. The target services and bases are known, but the per-service operation paths, request and response shapes and error envelopes of RWB-P2-E2001-CON and of the rwb-source-data contract are not published in the source documents.
evidence: RWB E2 001 v1 s12 code blocks; context pack P3 REST base and naming rules; no P1 or P2 operation inventory in the read-only set
proposed: RWB-P2-E2001-CON publishes the candidate page and the EFS history page; the rwb-source-data contract stories publish the ledger append, the REC-05 break and the REC-01 result; this story then names the paths.

title: Interaction ledger ownership conflicts with the legacy write and the P3 data model
source: RWB-E2-001 s4 step 8 and s11 DF-INT rows; Template and Rules R3 default ruling and DP-18; TSD P3 v3 T3.1
description: The legacy story appends DF-INT interaction rows as its own write and the P3 TSD defines interaction in the P3 data model, while the default ruling and DP-18 give the interaction ledger to rwb-source-data, and a P3 story for the ledger store also exists. Which service owns the table and which service writes it is recorded as a conflict; this story takes the default ruling and writes only through the rwb-source-data contract.
evidence: RWB E2 001 v1 s4 step 8, s11 DF-INT-002 to DF-INT-013; Template and Rules R3 default rulings and R5.5 DP-18; TSD P3 v3 T3.1 interaction object
proposed: Keep the ledger in rwb-source-data under DP-18 and re-scope the P3 ledger story to the P1 contract; mark the P3 TSD interaction object as owned by rwb-source-data.

title: Depends on (build) is empty while the DP table adds platform H dependencies
source: WP story line; Template and Rules R5.5
description: The patterns applied by this story add H dependencies RWB-PLT-E1027-CON (DP-03), RWB-PLT-TE006-CON (DP-09), RWB-PLT-E1071-CON (DP-10), RWB-PLT-E1042-CON (DP-06), RWB-PLT-E1043-CON (DP-07) and RWB-PLT-N001-CON (DP-19), but the story line carries no Depends on (build) value and the metadata row is copied as None.
evidence: WP B2-P3-020 story line H: []; Template and Rules R5.5 DP-03, DP-06, DP-07, DP-09, DP-10, DP-19
proposed: The assembler adds the platform CON dependencies to the lane and to the Day-1 allocation, keeping the metadata row as delivered by the WP.

title: CaseCreated payload and the resume of a held run are not specified
source: RWB-E2-001 s4 and s12; FSD P3 A2.27 and A2.31
description: The sources name the event CaseCreated (EV-01) and the messages of a held run, but not the payload fields of the event, the retry and dead-letter settings of rwb.case.events.v1, or how a run held at the 09:00 cut-off is resumed and what the screens show while it is held. The payload is written as IDs and facts only and the resume is a durable timer, which are assumptions.
evidence: RWB E2 001 v1 s4 steps 7 and 9, s12 job paragraph; FSD P3 A2.31 event table; context pack event naming rules
proposed: RWB-PLT-E1047-CON and RWB-PLT-TE006-CON fix the envelope and the retry settings; the event payload is limited to caseId, caseNo, productGroup, personKey, businessDate, accountKeys, entryDate and dpdAtEntry.
